rust_summary: attachment reads that never insert the default (`AttachmentType::has`, `AttachmentType::get_existing`).
doc_summary:
attachment reads that never insert the default: `AttachmentType::has` says whether a holder carries a value, saved or set,
even before it decodes (NeoForge's `hasData`), and `AttachmentType::get_existing` returns `None` instead of the default
(NeoForge's `getExistingData`). Neither adds anything to the holder's saved data. Bundles that use them need `"hooks": @API:attachment_existing@`.
